chunks: And Marwan ibn Muslim narrated from Abdullah ibn Hilal, who said:
I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: "The one who neglects zakat after it has become obligatory for him is like the one who withholds it after it has become due upon him."
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about someone who neglects zakat after it becomes obligatory?
ai.summary: This hadith equates neglecting zakat after its obligation is established with actively withholding it when it is due. It emphasizes the grave seriousness of failing to fulfill this financial act of worship and duty.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1596 - Marwan ibn Muslim reported from Abdullah ibn Hilal, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) say:
"The one who neglects Zakat after it has become obligatory upon him is like the one who withholds it after it has become due."
